# Conversations

[English](conversations.md) | [简体中文](../zh-CN/api-reference/conversations.md)

[Back to the API Reference index](README.md)

Conversations, members, history requests, read state, mute, pins and labels.

## Operations on this page

- [`deleteConversationLabel`](#delete-conversation-label): Delete a conversation label
- [`getConversation`](#get-conversation): Get conversation details
- [`listConversationLabels`](#list-conversation-labels): List conversation labels
- [`listConversationMembers`](#list-conversation-members): List conversation members
- [`listConversations`](#list-conversations): List conversations
- [`markConversationRead`](#mark-conversation-read): Mark a conversation as read
- [`markConversationUnread`](#mark-conversation-unread): Mark a conversation as unread
- [`muteConversation`](#mute-conversation): Mute a conversation
- [`pinConversation`](#pin-conversation): Pin a conversation
- [`requestConversationHistory`](#request-conversation-history): Request earlier conversation history
- [`setConversationLabelMembers`](#set-conversation-label-members): Add or remove a conversation label
- [`unmuteConversation`](#unmute-conversation): Unmute a conversation
- [`unpinConversation`](#unpin-conversation): Unpin a conversation
- [`upsertConversationLabel`](#upsert-conversation-label): Create or update a conversation label

## `getConversation`

Get conversation details

| Property        | Value                                                                       |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

<a id="list-conversations"></a>

## `listConversations`

List conversations

WhatsApp returns favorite conversations without label_id, or label members with it. Other channels retain their conversation semantics. Twitter returns user conversations only. Pass next_cursor unchanged while has_more=true; the last page omits it. Invalid/incomplete cursors return 400 provider_invalid_request.

| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `GET` `/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations`                               |

<a id="mark-conversation-read"></a>

## `markConversationRead`

Mark a conversation as read

Read targets depend on the account's channel. Telegram requires one received native up_to_message_id from this conversation, for example an inbound message.received data.message.id, not the send response or top-level event ID. Marks through that message inclusive; whole-conversation mode and nonempty sender ID are unsupported. WhatsApp message-level reads require nonempty message and sender IDs together. Omit both, or provide both blank after trimming, for whole-conversation mode. data.ok=true confirms the operation, not the peer's read state; no new Webhook is added.

| Property        | Value                                                                            |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations/read`                            |
| SDK method      | `device.markConversationRead(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["markConversationRead"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                             |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                          |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                             |

### Parameters

| SDK field                | Location | Required | Type     | Example     | Constraints | Description                                                   |
| ------------------------ | -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `params.path.account_id` | path     | Yes      | `string` | `"acc_xxx"` | -           | Public account ID issued by the API, for example acc_example. |

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                          | Required | Type     | Constraints | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `body.conversation_id`         | Yes      | `string` | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `body.up_to_message_id`        | No       | `string` | -           | String read target with channel-specific validation. Telegram requires one received native message ID: trimmed ASCII decimal 1-2147483647, no lists/signs/decimals/exponents/internal spaces/Unicode digits. Marks through that message inclusive; omission/zero is not whole-conversation mode. WhatsApp accepts one ID or comma-separated IDs from one sender, paired with nonempty sender ID. Omitting both or supplying both blank after trimming means whole-conversation read. |
| `body.up_to_message_sender_id` | No       | `string` | -           | WhatsApp message-level sender paired with nonempty message IDs; use Webhook data.sender.id for groups. Multiple IDs must share a sender. Nonempty sender is invalid for Telegram.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | The operation succeeded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Invalid public/channel read targets return invalid_request (10000); channel parameter rejection returns provider_invalid_request (30001).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `404`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The resource or route does not exist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Server request processing failed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The account's channel does not support this capability.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel unavailable or invalid response. Protocol login restriction uses 30020: stop automatic retry and check the official WhatsApp app. WhatsApp disconnection uses 30021 across messages/contacts/groups: pause dependent requests, refresh runtime, restore connection and confirm running before resuming. It does not prove logout or invalid authorization, nor automatically retry/reconnect/change state. 30010 may include an original reason; branch on codes, not text. WhatsApp group-admin send rejection uses 34012: resolve permissions before resending. |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                           | Present | Type      | Constraints | Description                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | --------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`        | No      | `string`  | -           | The request ID generated by the server.                                |
| `result.data.client_request_id` | No      | `string`  | -           | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header. |
| `result.data.data`              | Yes     | `OkData`  | -           | -                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.ok`           | Yes     | `boolean` | const=true  | -                                                                      |

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.markConversationRead({
  params: {
    path: {
      account_id: "acc_xxx"
    }
  },
  body: {
    conversation_id: "-1001234567890",
    up_to_message_id: "12345"
  }
});
console.log(result.data.data);
```

<a id="request-conversation-history"></a>

## `requestConversationHistory`

Request earlier conversation history

WhatsApp user conversations only, excluding whatsapp-protocol. Use a native content message's complete before anchor from the same conversation. account_id must be a nonblank single path segment without whitespace or slash, including encoded slash; invalid paths return 400 invalid_request. HTTP 202 accepted does not return messages or prove completion. Subscribe to conversation.history first; available asynchronous batches carry data.history.source=on_demand. request_id is diagnostic, not a task ID. One request can produce multiple, repeated, late or no batches. Continue from the earliest native content message with id/sent_at/direction. Synthetic call records are not anchors; before has no type field, so callers must exclude them. No next cursor or completion state is provided; empty/short batches and timeouts do not prove exhaustion. Do not automatically retry unknown outcomes. Groups/channels return 400 unsupported_conversation_type; other channels return 501 unsupported_by_provider.

| Property        | Value                                                                                  |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations/history/request`                       |
| SDK method      | `device.requestConversationHistory(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["requestConversationHistory"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                                   |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                                |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                                   |

### Parameters

| SDK field                | Location | Required | Type     | Example     | Constraints | Description                                                   |
| ------------------------ | -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `params.path.account_id` | path     | Yes      | `string` | `"acc_xxx"` | -           | Public account ID issued by the API, for example acc_example. |

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                    | Required | Type                                   | Constraints                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `body.conversation_id`   | Yes      | `string`                               | pattern="^[0-9]+@lid$"            | WhatsApp user LID matching the anchor conversation; phone numbers and other conversation types are invalid.                                                                                                     |
| `body.before`            | Yes      | `ConversationHistoryBefore`            | -                                 | Position of one native content message in the same conversation; all fields come from that message and cannot be null. Synthetic call records are invalid even with complete fields; no type field is accepted. |
| `body.before.message_id` | Yes      | `string`                               | minLength=1, pattern="\\S"        | Native content message ID, never a synthetic call-record ID, including after trimming. Event IDs/request IDs are not substitutes.                                                                               |
| `body.before.sent_at`    | Yes      | `string (date-time)`                   | -                                 | Message RFC3339 sent_at with Unix seconds >0; do not substitute occurred_at or current time.                                                                                                                    |
| `body.before.direction`  | Yes      | `string enum("inbound" \| "outbound")` | enum="inbound", "outbound"        | Direction relative to this account: inbound received, outbound sent.                                                                                                                                            |
| `body.limit`             | No       | `integer`                              | minimum=1, maximum=50, default=50 | Requested count, not guaranteed result count. Default 50 only when omitted; null/zero/nonintegers/>50 return invalid_request.                                                                                   |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `202`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | History request accepted; available batches are asynchronous and completion is not guaranteed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | invalid_request for invalid fields/account paths; provider_invalid_request for invalid channel anchors, including synthetic call records; unsupported_conversation_type for unsupported targets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `404`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Valid account path but missing/out-of-workspace account: account_not_found (20020).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Unclassified history request error: request_conversation_history_failed (37016).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The account's channel does not support this capability.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel unavailable or invalid response. Protocol login restriction uses 30020: stop automatic retry and check the official WhatsApp app. WhatsApp disconnection uses 30021 across messages/contacts/groups: pause dependent requests, refresh runtime, restore connection and confirm running before resuming. It does not prove logout or invalid authorization, nor automatically retry/reconnect/change state. 30010 may include an original reason; branch on codes, not text. WhatsApp group-admin send rejection uses 34012: resolve permissions before resending. |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `202` response fields:

| Field                              | Present | Type                          | Constraints           | Description                                                            |
| ---------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`           | No      | `string`                      | -                     | The request ID generated by the server.                                |
| `result.data.client_request_id`    | No      | `string`                      | -                     | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header. |
